warnings: Budget capture is Organizations - Special Budget, not the whole national budget. The terminal lines reconcile to its published parent totals.
2024 is actual, 2025 revised, and 2026–2028 budget; appropriations do not prove spending, delivery, service frequency or current route subsidy receipts.
Programme hierarchy totals overlap their descendants; only terminal lines are exposed as additive programme allocations.
MTCC figures are Group Note 29 accounts; Company tables and rounded management charts are separate presentations, not additional independent measurements.
Business-segment profits include accounting allocations and operational support; no aggregate account has been converted into cost per trip, route, passenger or km.
MTCC annual passenger categories overlap one another and potentially MBS monthly series; source definitions must be reconciled before any combined series is made.

HIES 2019 estimates cover Republic, Malé and Atolls aggregates only. Means, medians and shares are nonadditive; percentages explicitly convert published fractions. Nominal 2019 amounts are not current local travel affordability.
